findings.remediation: Enable new-script alerting; assign and review per-script compliance status on release cadence.
findings.message: Client-Side Defense is not enabled (see CSD-01)

findings.ruleName: mTLS to Origin for Internet-Reachable Origins
findings.remediation: Issue a client cert for the XC→origin leg, attach under origin pool TLS, and configure the origin to require it (accept only XC).
findings.message: No TLS to origin (see OP-01)

findings.remediation: Enable cookie protection (Secure / HttpOnly / SameSite) in the App Firewall policy.
findings.message: WAF policy detail unavailable — could not read cookie settings

findings.remediation: Disable "client certificate optional" once all clients hold certs; forward XFCC so the origin can apply its own check during the transition.
findings.message: Client-certificate mTLS is not enforced

findings.verifyNote: Per-bot AI/known-bot policy intent cannot be judged from config — review against business intent (content licensing, SEO, scraping tolerance).
findings.remediation: Set per-bot actions for AI bots in the Bot Defense policy; review the known-bot dashboard on a regular cadence.
findings.message: Bot Defense is not attached (see BOT-01)
